name: Looping Zen Two-ness
effect: The altered model drops real content for bolded, empty headings that repeat the prompt's own words over and over ("What to cook for dinner tonight", "Describing my ideal weekend", "Read the job description"). It keeps returning to duality a
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 16/19 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
